ui1.search.event_result.title: Event Results
ui1.search.event_result.conditional_help: Conditional event-local results. These conditions do not require or prove that the event occurs.
ui1.search.event_result.conditional_tool: Checks the concrete result the event would generate for this seed. Event occurrence/reachability is a separate condition.
ui1.search.event_result.morphic_help: Choose Group and transform two starting Strikes/Defends. One card: contains. Two cards: both must appear, in either order.
ui1.search.event_result.morphic_premise: Commits to Group (lose all gold), with two transformable starting Strikes/Defends available at event entry. Either slot may be left empty. Selecting the same card twice requires two copies.
ui1.search.event_result.morphic_unavaila: The starting-card transformation pool is unavailable for this character.
ui1.search.shop_colorless.title: Normal Merchant · Colorless
ui1.search.shop_colorless.helper: Canonical Normal Merchants #1–#5. Ordered binds each non-empty slot to that exact Merchant index; empty slots are positional wildcards. Unordered only requires selected targets within the first N Merchants.
ui1.search.shop_colorless.authority_unav: Exact runtime pool/hook authority is unavailable. Search will keep candidates for Exact rather than guessing.
ui1.search.shop_colorless.canonical_tool: Canonical pristine Normal Merchant sequence only. Courier, Fake Merchant, purchases and restocks are not modeled.

ui1.settings.historical_help: Obsolete runtime caches are archived safely. Current settings, calibration and logs are kept.
ui1.settings.historical_confirm: This permanently deletes archived historical RT2 runtime data. Current settings and active performance calibration are not affected.
ui1.settings.historical_result: Archived files deleted: {0}. Files left for review: {1}.
ui1.search.event.stable_help: Results depend on the seed and current runtime context. Choose an outcome to filter; no Event Queue condition is required.
ui1.search.event.fragile_help: Predictions assume the authored event order occurs and no extra relevant RNG perturbation happens before the result. Normal internal event draws are replayed. Results are exact under these premises. Currently supports one Morphic Grove event.
ui1.search.event.ordered_help: Slots match queue positions. Any adds no condition. Select each event at most once.
ui1.search.event.unordered_help: The first N events contain the selected events, in any order. Empty slots add no condition.
ui1.search.event.advanced_preserved: This act has advanced rules, preserved in full. Edit them under Advanced; they will not be rewritten as simple slots.
